prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Lead (Pb) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall
Outfit: a tight cropped knit top baring the waist and a snug bodycon mini skirt, with high heels — in clean neutrals such as white, ivory, oatmeal or soft grey; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated, leaning slightly forward toward the table, forearms near its edge.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she raises a camera to her eye to take a photo — her own right hand on the grip, finger on the shutter, her own left hand supports the lens from below.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: one eye is set close to the eyepiece or viewfinder of what she holds, looking through it.
EXPRESSION: soft distant eyes, faint wistful half-smile, brows gently raised at the inner ends.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — lead: a dull blue-grey metal, heavy and soft enough to scratch with a fingernail — the stable end where uranium's long decay chain finally comes to rest; the shield that stops X-rays and radiation, the dark came that joins the pieces of stained glass, the cast type of the printing press, the Roman water pipes that gave plumbing its name; alchemy's Saturn; it tastes sweet but is poison; heavy, quiet and guarding — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

No obvious additional disconnected limb visible.
Used only the selected world image as reference.
